overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics between couples (husband-wife) significantly outperform other general emotional or family topics, pulling over 1,700 views consistently. Pure sad poetry or generic quotes underperform heavily.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about husband-wife dynamics ('पत्नी की ये बात...' and 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?') generated massive outliers with 1,666 and 1,764 views.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, marital communication gaps, and post-marriage emotional realities.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos relying purely on philosophical or dark poetry ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…') got only 10 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract or overly poetic dark lines; ground content in everyday relatable observations.
